_source: Adapted from countinghouse by Charles Zheng (MIT), https://github.com/goodnight000/countinghouse, server/src/derive.ts franchiseTax() and server/smoke.ts
_verify: Every number here is the source's claim as of its 2026-09-27 snapshot. Check the current schedule, minimums, caps, the annual report fee and late penalties against the Delaware Division of Corporations franchise tax page (corp.delaware.gov/paytaxes) before filing. This skill computes; it does not file.
due: March 1 each year, for the prior calendar year, for a Delaware C-corporation.

authorized_shares_method.note: Delaware's default notice uses this method, which is why a company with 10,000,000 authorized shares is told $85,215.

steps: assumed par = total gross assets / issued shares, floored at the stated par value
assumed par value capital (APVC) = assumed par x authorized shares
tax = $400 per $1,000,000 of APVC or portion thereof, minimum $400, capped at $200,000
assumed_par_value_capital_method.note: The company files with whichever method gives the lower tax. Gross assets come from the company's own balance sheet as of the fiscal year end; the source projects them from cash plus hardware, which is a modeling shortcut.

worked_examples.name: zero assets floors at the minimum
